_comment: Copy to <job folder>/job.json (outside the repo). Paths are relative to the job file. Run: python3 -I engineers.py <job>.json --plan, then without --plan. Theme card: edit-reel/references/themes/engineers-matter-ai.md

speech._: source seconds the talk lives in. Pauses longer than min_pause are shortened to 2 x keep and the take is cut there: a hard cut (default), few. lead/tail = room tone kept before the first and after the last word.

pieces._: same span as speech; only --align reads pieces

reel._: crop = the inspiration reel only (never usernames or comments); width 968 for a tall card. seconds = the part of the recording with real motion (find it by frame differencing), NOT the idle tail: it is retimed 0.6x-1.6x to play for the whole time the card is up

demo._: crop = the page content, without the browser tabs and address bar. width 2016 for the wide window

demo_panel._: a tighter crop with the same 1.877 aspect, e.g. the class cards

stacks.label: @<creator handle read from the post header>
stacks._: kind tall = reel card left, presenter right; at = SOURCE seconds. label = the creator's Instagram handle (credit)
a wide window with layers one after another

layers._: black-and-white A->B map: A start, route draws to the street where a map app says arrived (cue arrive), the last 50 m dashed (cue last50), B = Pinecone Academy lights up (cue solved). All cues in SOURCE seconds

scenes._: recording t/seconds shown while the presenter says the words between at[0] and at[1] (source seconds); retimed 0.5x-2.2x
a scene can use another crop of the recording (screens.demo_panel = a close-up of a side panel). Every stretch of the recording once: no replays

chapters.label: Асуудал
chapters._: the chapter pill swaps in place at each chapter start; no transition on chapter changes. First chapter starts after the opening small talk

captions: source-time from|to|text, 2-4 words. Times may be rough: run --align once the text is final. [hidden words] are spoken but not shown (they only help --align)
_end_card: "default" = assets/end_card_9x16.mp4 from the brand pack (skipped when missing); or a path; or omit
_speech_over_bed_db: speech level over the track in dB: 12 in the 30 s cut (louder music, voice still clearly on top), 16 in the long cut
_music_style: upbeat swing-jazz bed. bpm = tempo (108), key = transpose in semitones, seed = which fills are played.
_camera: 0 (default) = locked-off. 0.4 = a slow push/pull/drift on about 4 in 10 takes (rejected on EP01 as weird). camera_seed, transition_seed, fx_seed change patterns
_transitions: cut (default) = hard cuts inside pauses, like the testimonial reels. auto = rotating soft dissolves/wipes (tried on EP01, rejected as repetitive)
_leaks: the intro->first shot leak (pink) is automatic. leaks_at = SOURCE seconds (or {at, tone: pink|green}) where one more leak is necessary: episode 1 uses green where the story starts and pink/purple at the two chapter changes. Never on cuts. off = none
_caption_y: caption bottom edge in px (1620 = bottom of the screen). Captions use the testimonial-reel style: GIP (brand pack) white, no box, hard cut on/off
_intro_meta: false (default) = the intro and sign-off show only the title. true = also the EP tag and the pinecone mark + wordmark top row (earlier versions).
_chapter_style: pill (default) or rail: a slim process rail (a bead travels along a line, the step lights up as it arrives) beside the chapter name. The chapter name always resolves out of green noise (dual-scramble).
_look: split (default) = demo edge to edge on top (1080x575), presenter under it, chapter plate callouts, like the reviewer's reference reel. cards = the earlier rounded-card layout over a blurred room.
_show_chapters: false (default): no chapter labels on screen. true: a plate callout (split look) or a pill (cards look) at each chapter start from `chapters`.
_caption_style: plate (default) = white Tinos serif on a tight black plate like the reference reel; gip = the testimonial-reel caption (brand-pack font, no box)
_music_file: optional: a supplied track replaces the synthesized bed (download audio only with yt-dlp -x --audio-format m4a --no-playlist <url>). Check the licence; put music_credit in the post caption. Omit for the synthesized swing-jazz bed.
_caption_face: serif of the black-plate caption: source (default, slim Source Serif 4 40 px) | tinos | cormorant
_opening: none = the talk starts on frame 0 (30 s cut); omit for the old 3.9 s Ghost Text intro first
_closer: true = the Ghost Text title plays at the END after a pink leak (replaces the sign-off); needs no end_card

clips._: source seconds of a clip to keep, in the order they play. Edges snap to the quietest 40 ms beside them (snap:false turns it off). Total of all clips + 5 s closer must be <= 30 s

_brand_moments: source-second spans where a company is named: colour wash + logo above the head + tinted caption word. name: claude | higgsfield. Logos are third-party trademarks, so assets/claude_mark.png and assets/higgsfield_mark.png are git-ignored: put your own copies there (512 px PNG, transparent or app icon); without them only the wordmark shows
_name_tag: plain text, no plate (name white semibold, role soft white, both with a soft shadow) lower left; slides in/out smoothly; name in Mongolian, role in English; shown once at the start. closer_signature: true would also sign the closer (off by default)
_closer_ep: small episode label under the closer title (episode 1 shows it only there)
_target_seconds: the closer is lengthened (4.4-7 s) so the whole video lands on this length; reviewer allowed 32 s for episode 1 (the closer gets the leftover time); default 30
